verdicts.argument: The specification does not provide sufficient detail to determine the scope and duration of site preparation, so the claim is not rebuttable.
The quantity discrepancy between excavation and disposal is not addressed by any clause in the documents, so the objection stands.
No clause specifies the thickness of the asphalt base layer, so the claim cannot be rebutted.
The contract does not define mortar type or joint width, so the objection remains.
The depth and presence of a slab for the shaft are not specified, so the claim cannot be rebutted.
The concrete screed thickness is not defined in the documents, so the objection stands.
The type and thickness of the interior plaster are not specified, so the claim cannot be rebutted.
The asphalt top layer thickness is not defined, so the objection remains.
The material and thickness of the frost protection layer are not specified, so the claim cannot be rebutted.
The pressure rating and installation details for the PE-HD pipe are not defined, so the objection stands.
The required insulation thickness and thermal conductivity are not specified, so the claim cannot be rebutted.
The homogeneous area per DIN 18300 is not defined, so the objection remains.
